content.text:
Here is the assembled pump. Some connections were inferred because the kit doesn't make them explicit:

- **Stack:** The base plate sits on the ground. The pump body stands on it, with its narrow section down and the bulged section up. The cap sits on top of the body.
- **Spout:** It points left, with its outlet turned down. I placed its large flange on the widest point of the body's bulge. The body shows no port, so that height is a guess.
- **Ear holes:** The cap's ear is on the right and has two holes. I used the upper one, because the lower one would put the rod's top inside the cap. The lower hole is left empty.
- **Handle linkage:** The link bar runs from that upper ear hole to the handle's small middle hole. The handle's rounded end is pinned to the piston rod's top hole, on the body's centre line.
- **Piston:** It hangs inside the bore, mid-stroke.
- **Handle angle:** The grip sits horizontal. If the handle's angle is graded against a different reference pose, it may fall outside the 8° tolerance.

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1376 768">
  <use href="#kit-base_plate" transform="translate(543,650)"/>
  <use href="#kit-pump_body" transform="translate(613.75,720.1) rotate(-110)"/>
  <use href="#kit-spout" transform="translate(418.9,612.6) rotate(-125)"/>
  <use href="#kit-piston_rod" transform="translate(556.61,433.79) rotate(-70)"/>
  <use href="#kit-cap" transform="translate(551.46,280.10) rotate(-55)"/>
  <use href="#kit-link_bar" transform="translate(840.55,69.28) rotate(18.33)"/>
  <use href="#kit-handle_lever" transform="translate(646.04,148.40) rotate(-48.6)"/>
</svg>
```
